about_the_game:
Off the Beaten Track is a couch/online arcade action game where fearless pilots battling in chaotic aerial arenas across the galaxy.

Whether you're just here to mess around with friends or to show off your next-level piloting skills, this game has room for both. The controls are easy to pick up, but mastering the skies? That’s a whole different story.

Casual fun or competitive flair — the choice is yours. Just don’t expect anything to go as planned once you're Off the Beaten Track.

  • Local/online multiplayer for up to 4 players

  • 10 unique pilots & flying machines

  • 40+ weapons: bullets, rockets, lasers, mines and other

  • 10 interactable arenas

  • Accessible arcade-style controls with skill-based depth

  • A playful, stylized world that doesn’t take itself too seriously

  • Perfect for party nights or sweaty 1v1 grudge matches
